_doc: REAPER legs (another_robot.glb, the gaunt rifle droid). World after import: Z up (0..1.93), X = width, Y = front/back (the rifle reaches to y -1.17 at z 0.8-1.4). The legs are two columns under the hips at z 0.85, spread over three of the body meshes; everything below the hips at y > -0.5 (clear of the rifle's front end) is a leg, by side (the scene yaws the model 180 deg, so Blender -x is the body's RIGHT: the names follow the body). The model ships posed mid-stride, one leg reaching back; enemy_reaper.gd straightens each leg at rest. The rifle's materials (Gun1, Gun2) are claimed first so they stay whole objects. tools/blender/split_regions.py
